title: Replacement Days for a Lost or Stolen Supply
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — the replacement fill paid under a lost or stolen override.**

**Rule.** The replacement is the days still on hand from the latest paid refill, which are that refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled, never fewer than one day. The replacement days are a whole number of days and are never fewer than one day.

### Working lines

| Line | Entry |
|---|---|
| A | Days supply of the latest paid refill of the drug |
| B | Calendar days since that refill was filled |
| C | A less B |
| D | Replacement days: C, never fewer than one day |

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Latest paid refill | Days since it was filled | Replacement days |
|---|---|---|
| 30 days | 12 | 18 |
| 30 days | 29 | 1 |
| 30 days | 31 | 1 (never fewer than one day) |
